associations.rationale: extCochainMap constructs the cochain-complex map induced by a resolution morphism, an ingredient for Ext comparison maps.
The type gives only the Ext comparison-isomorphism component; it does not itself state the required independence of compatible lifts.
extLiftMap constructs an Ext morphism from a selected reverse chain lift, rather than asserting its independence or isomorphism.
extLiftMap_eq_comparison identifies a compatible lift's induced map with extComparison; this establishes a construction detail rather than the comparison-isomorphism claim itself.
The type gives only the compatible-lift independence component; it does not itself state the Ext comparison-isomorphism component required by the complete source claim.
